id: title:VojtechBartos:admit the presigned upload endpoint to connect src

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a Content Security Policy (CSP) `connect-src` directive entry for the configured object storage bucket, enabling browsers to POST presigned upload requests while restricting access to HTTPS and the specific bucket, supporting PostHog's file upload bypass feature.
review.reason: The change adds a helper function and its invocation to construct a CSP origin, and the middleware uses this to include the bucket URL in the `connect-src` directive. This establishes a security boundary for the upload workflow. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow maintenance is demonstrated; the implementation and relevant checks are visible, supporting a tier 2.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the supplied hunks being complete and the helper implementation not containing hidden dependencies or broader architectural changes not shown. The benefit is the security enforcement, not the adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are available and complete; no abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function object_storage_upload_source() that constructs a connect-src origin including the bucket, and its scheme is forced to https unless in debug/test.
observations.code_quote: scheme = parts.scheme if settings.DEBUG or settings.TEST else "https"
observations.posthog_connection: This value is injected into the CSP connect-src directive, allowing browsers to POST presigned upload requests to the configured object storage bucket. The bucket is included to prevent requests from reaching other buckets on the same host, and the scheme is upgraded to https for production. This supports the PostHog feature where file uploads bypass Django and go directly to S3 or

observations.behavior: Calls the new helper to obtain the object storage source and assigns it to a variable.
observations.posthog_connection: This variable is used downstream to populate the CSP policy, establishing the connection between the helper and the middleware's enforcement of the policy.

observations.behavior: Adds the object_storage_source variable to the connect-src CSP directive, alongside other allowed origins.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk demonstrates the actual enforcement: the CSP header returned by the middleware now includes the object storage origin, allowing the browser to POST to it. This is the mechanism that permits the presigned upload while restricting it to the configured bucket and enforcing HTTPS.
